scoring_justification: Step1 recomputes MAE from raw total energies; paper reports -0.38 meV/f.u. for the relaxed structure. The recomputed value is compared with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold MAE value for Fe2AlB2 relaxed structure
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.3(b) and text: K100 = -0.38 meV/f.u. using relaxed structure.
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the paper's reported numeric value
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The value is a direct quote from the paper; no fabrication needed.

outputs.description: Total occupied band energies for Fe2AlB2 with magnetization along [001] and [100], computed via DFT+SOC.

required: line 2: Easy axis = a, b, or c (whichever is determined)

outputs.description: Summary of the computed magnetocrystalline anisotropy energy and easy-axis orientation.

output_contract.notes: The scope focuses on the MAE calculation, which is the main quantitative claim of the paper. Co-equal results on Mn2AlB2 ground state, doping effects, and magnetoelastic effect require exchange-parameter calculations via linear-response and CPA/mean-field Tc estimation that are beyond the feasibility of a straightforward DFT reproduction with the current toolchain and would introduce additional uncertainty. They are omitted with this justification.
